scope: Expand the previously approved immutable-release deduplication allowlist to exactly six owned old releases; no change to deduplication behavior or resource guards.
checks: Previous local script SHA exactly matches its approved review pin. Text diff and AST comparison confirm that only OWN_OLD changes; executable logic is otherwise identical.

The allowlist contains only six explicitly named prior releases created in this task. Current wb-cohort release is absent; under the common lock the actual current target is resolved and each old target must differ from it.
Candidates remain limited to regular files listed with the same digest in both manifests, distinct inodes, old nlink 1, and equal device/uid/gid/mode/size.
Only an old target inode is replaced by a temporary hardlink and atomic rename. Differing files, symlinks, existing shared targets, manifests and the current release are not rewritten.
All current and old payload hashes and old manifest bytes are checked before/after processing; final current pointer equality is checked. Release paths and rollback content remain present.
No disk reserve, capacity guard, runtime config, archive content or unrelated files are modified by this script. Python compilation passes.

verification.independent_local: Exact text/AST allowlist-only delta and six-name bounds PASS; prior reviewed base SHA verified; compilation PASS.
verification.behavioral_basis: Same deduplication body previously passed a synthetic filesystem check covering identical files, different bytes/mode, symlinks, existing hardlinks and unchanged manifests; not repeated for this allowlist-only delta.

limitations: Actual recovered space depends on eligible distinct nlink=1 copies; already shared files produce no additional savings. Space recovery and archive capacity must be measured after execution rather than inferred from approval.
freed_bytes is total filesystem free-space delta and may include concurrent workload changes.
Shared immutable payloads must remain immutable; later modifications must replace destination inodes.
